title: hypericum perforatum subsp. veronense
intro: Hypericum perforatum subsp. veronense, commonly known as Alpine St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of the St. John's Wort plant, a flowering plant native to Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress, anxiety, and depression due to its adaptogenic properties, and it has also been used to treat sleep disorders and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Alpine St. John's Wort are attributed to its ability to modulate neurotransmitters, such as serotonin and dopamine, and to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and naphthodianthrones, particularly hyperforin and hypericin, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
